items.title: McDonald’s Testing New Budget-Friendly Value Meals as Sales Fall in Third Quarter
items.summary: McDonald’s is rolling out new cost-effective value meals in an attempt to offset third quarter declines and decreased traffic at U.S. locations. In an earnings call on Wednesday, November 4, the company’s CEO Chris Kempczinski revealed that McDonald’s began an eight-week test of mix-and-match fixed-price bundles at 1,900 restaurants in the last week of October.
